text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After an afternoon shopping, I start
heading home as the sun does the
same for
the night. I'm walking past the riverbank
when...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Hah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The shout rings in my ears, like the sharp
clang of an expertly wielded
blade. My
feet stop, and my head unconsciously
turns to the source.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Hup! ...Hah! ...Sei! ...Tah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Each punch, each kick... Her every
movement cuts cleanly through the

evening air, punctuated by that same
resounding, thunderous voice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Exhale... Keh... HYAH!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Exhale...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm so awestruck, I hardly catch myself
staring. Her form perfectly balances
ferocity with composure...
I can tell she's devoted countless
time to refining her art,
and it... it's beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pardon. May I have a word?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I notice that you don a Tracen Academy
badge. Did you need me for
something,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You really... Ahem.
That is far too high of
praise for one so
inexperienced as me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even now, my heart was not clear of
distractions. Tomorrow's tryouts linger in
my mind, no matter how I try to recollect
myself through
training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Still, an amateur though I am,
I will apply all my abilities to the race.
It would be an
honor to see you there, should your
schedule permit it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Why am I being so formal? I feel like I'm
talking to a wise old martial
artist, not a
student!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then, out of nowhere—

text_block_list.name: Thuggish Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, HEY! Who do you think you are? We don't need some little princess from the academy stinkin' up our turf!

text_block_list.name: Thuggish Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna use our spot, you're gonna
have to pay up and make it
worth our
while!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I turn my head to see two delinquents
sauntering over to us.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Your turf, you say? To my recollection,
this field is part of the public
park.

text_block_list.name: Thuggish Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Can it! You know what I damn mean,
smartass! Hey boss, this Uma's
bein' all
uppity!

text_block_list.name: Thuggish Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, she's uppity all right. But how
long's she gonna be able to keep the smug
act up? Just saying, but if you don't want
trouble, pay up or go back to playin' tag
on your school playground.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "boss" of the pair scowls at Yaeno
Muteki with an intimidating
leer... But I
can't let her get away with this!

text_block_list.name: Thuggish Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: The hell?! You stay outta this!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: HAH!

text_block_list.name: Thuggish Pair
text_block_list.text: Ah?! Gulp...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki's cry shocks the pair like a
bolt of lightning. They stop
still and look
at her wide-eyed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Are you going to press this
matter further?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her voice is light and calm,
like the quiet surface of a lake. At the
same time,
though, there's a cold, unfathomable
depth to it.

text_block_list.name: Thuggish Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, we're leaving. I can see we're
outmatched.

text_block_list.name: Thuggish Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Boss, wait! D-don't leave without
meee!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for raising my voice.
I thought
only to resolve the
situation at hand, but I
am sorry if I startled you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm just amazed by the way she
demonstrated such raw power without 
letting her composure slip for a second.
There wasn't even a hint of anger on her
face!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...You flatter me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now I'm really curious what her running is like. I excuse myself for the evening, bubbling with excitement for the tryouts tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And, come the next day, that excitement
only builds. I head to the
track to watch
Yaeno Muteki's race, and start looking
around.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
That one there, Super Creek—she was
amazing out there! She's
already made
such a strong impression on everyone.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap stood out too. I can see why
they call her the Beast. She's still rough
around the edges, but there's definitely a
real gem hiding
in her.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
There are so many promising racers at the
tryouts this time. We're in
for some wild
races when this generation hits the big
tracks.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I'm here too. This time,
I'll prove myself.
I'll reap the fruits of my
training and win
glory today—I swear I will!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Panting...

text_block_list.name: Racer
text_block_list.text: ...All right, here goes. Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're not... passing me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Racer
text_block_list.text: Hehe, she really did fall for it!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki... Looks like she took the
bait. If she doesn't regain her
head
quickly, she'll burn all her energy before
the last spurt.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
To think she'd make the same mistake
again... She had so much potential, but if
she can't keep cool in races,
that's the end
of it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe my eyes. The Yaeno Muteki
I saw yesterday was so composed. She
wielded the fiery spirit within her like a
tempered blade, keeping it quiet in its
sheath until the moment she struck! But 
now...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I swear... I'll keep... pushing ahead!
Hraaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She rampages with a wild ferocity. Unable
to temper the flames within
her, Yaeno
Muteki burns up her energy and loses the
race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How could I... let this happen again?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Amateur! I keep making such... such
amateur mistakes! I won't be able
to
restrain the blaze within me like this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can see frustration written all over her
face, and yet, I can't summon
the words to
speak up. Silently, helplessly, I watch as
she leaves...
